original_fit_config.objective: Add one fixed generic Kinetics R2Plus1D_18 visual modality to the unchanged v3 template nested emotion expert. Test complementary within-scene visual movement/pose evidence with no outer-score selection.
original_fit_config.validation_weight_source: Unlabeled test structure: 31 complete-core scenes, 16 one-pair scenes and one no-pair scene; the 51 partial-group questions contain 32 paired-core rows and 19 singleton rows. All 48 test scenes retain three questions.
original_fit_config.selection: Independently maximize complete-core inner accuracy and partial-core inner view-weighted accuracy; ties use inner worst subject then the original decoder order. Each selected decoder applies to the whole group, never selected outer rows or subjects.
original_fit_config.constraints: At inference use unchanged v1 feasible assignments inside audited scenes. Complete means exactly three questions with three shared words. All other groups use the inner-selected partial decoder. Synthetic partial views keep each question and its options/evidence, constrain one of three pairs to the shared core, and leave the other row unrestricted while retaining distinct-word joint assignment.
original_fit_config.validation_caveat: Acquisition positions remain explicit unlabeled metadata. Relaxed-core proxies test the assignment graph but do not recreate partial-question vocabulary or missing records. Repeated views are dependent; historical subjects and v2b error slices were observed. This is strict model/selection subject exclusion, not a newly untouched blind test; no outer-score or public-score selection is allowed. Historical v3/v4 external errors were reviewed before this fixed visual hypothesis. Generic embeddings are coarse motion/pose evidence, not a pretrained emotion classifier. No outer label, score or selected row may tune this new modality.

visual_specification.aggregation: Depth mean,std then IR mean,std over 8 windows; population std
visual_specification.relative_normalization: unchanged sensor_matrix within complete three-recording scene
visual_specification.invalid_unit_policy: omit missing or physically misaligned paired video; disable visual for its whole scene
visual_specification.duplicate_windows: retain fixed eight-window sample; zero std is allowed
